name: Agrona

attributes.attribute: kin of the death queen Mórrígan

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Agrona was an obscure British goddess of war. She was found in Britain and perhaps in Wales. Some scholars describe her as kin of the Irish death queen Mórrígan.

okr.objective: Record the obscure British war goddess Agrona.
key_results: Show her homelands and her link to the Mórrígan.
